# GraphQL Inspector Automated Breaking Change Detection

Automated CI detection of breaking GraphQL schema changes: detecting removed fields, type changes, or added non-null arguments.

## Invariants
- FAIL_CI_ON_BACKWARD_INCOMPATIBLE_SCHEMA_CHANGES
- DEPRECATE_BEFORE_REMOVING_FIELDS
- DIFF_AGAINST_PRODUCTION_SCHEMA
